recipe: For each existing signature gene: reference expression * frozen normalized module node weight; group sum divided by total loading gives four nonnegative fractions. Component score = mean of original within-cancer gene z times attribution fraction. Do not reselect genes or restandardize component scores; sum exactly equals original score.
qualification: descriptive component rank association only if mean gene attribution mass >=0.05 and Kish effective genes >=5, outcome-blind; preserve all components for algebra regardless of qualification
clinical: LF_single only; complete cases for purity age sex; n>=30. Partial Spearman uses rank component and rank LF residualized against rank purity, rank age and binary sex. No P values or new significance calls.
additive: Residualize unranked component scores and rank LF using same covariates; covariance contribution divided by full-score residual SD and LF residual SD. Components sum to full unranked-score/ranked-LF partial Pearson, NOT to full partial Spearman. No covariance-share division near zero.
limitations: Reference attribution not measured lineage expression or cell abundance. Shared genes remain shared; not immune-free scores, causal mediation, independent effects or clinical validation. Prior reference trained on inherited labels; no external validation.
